# Hotel Lärchenwald

![Hotel Lärchenwald in summer, with deck chairs on the meadow in front](../../../assets/hotel-aussen.jpg)

Our family has run Hotel Lärchenwald on the edge of Sils Maria since 1962. You will find 24 rooms, a restaurant serving Engadin cooking, and hiking trails that start right at the front door.

[See rooms and prices](/en/rooms/)

## Summer and winter

In summer, walk into the Fex valley or cycle around Lake Sils. In winter, the cross-country ski trail runs 200 metres from the hotel, and the ski bus stops outside.

## What our guests say

> “Quiet, warm, and a breakfast you won’t forget.” – The Keller family, Zurich

> “The quietest week we have had in years, and the staff knew our names on the second day.” – Sarah and Tom, London

## The season

Summer season: 11 June to 18 October 2026. Winter season: 18 December 2026 to 5 April 2027.

We are looking for people to join our team: [open jobs at the hotel](/en/jobs/).
